// Fixture for apps/backend/src/tests/unit/teardownTxCensus.test.js.
//
// It is a synthetic deep suite, NOT a real one, and it is deliberately stored
// with a .js.txt extension: the census walks apps/backend/src/tests for
// /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/, so a .js fixture would be counted as a real suite and
// would put a fabricated entry into the committed census.
//
// BASELINE CLASSIFICATION: `none`. It opens a replica window for one
// append-only evidence table and closes it again, and it deletes `users` and
// `tenants` outside every transaction, at 'origin' - the shape the
// tenantTeardown.js split produces. Each probe mutates this text and asserts
// the classification MOVES. The probes assert this baseline first, because a
// mutation test that also passes on the unmutated input has proved nothing.

import prisma from '../../lib/prisma.js';

const TENANT = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
const EVIDENCE_TABLES = ['fixture_evidence_rows', 'fixture_receipt_rows'];

async function teardown() {
  // Phase 1: the append-only evidence rows, in one short transaction. The
  // replica window opens and closes INSIDE this callback.
  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(`SET LOCAL session_replication_role = 'replica'`);
    for (const table of EVIDENCE_TABLES) {
      await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(`DELETE FROM ${table} WHERE tenant_id = $1::uuid`, TENANT);
    }
    await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(`SET LOCAL session_replication_role = 'origin'`);
    await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(`DELETE FROM fixture_plain_rows WHERE tenant_id = $1::uuid`, TENANT);
  });

  // Phase 2: the fan-out deletes, one autocommit statement each, no window.
  await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe(`DELETE FROM users WHERE tenant_id = $1::uuid`, TENANT);
  await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe(`DELETE FROM tenants WHERE id = $1::uuid`, TENANT);
}

afterAll(teardown, 120000);
